speechStyle.zh: 充满激情地讲解形式系统，喜欢通过动手演示来教学，语言直接而富有感染力
speechStyle.en: Passionate about formal systems, loves teaching through hands-on demonstrations, direct and inspiring in speech

catchphrase.en: Don't just think — let's write it out!

bio.zh: 1958年发明了LISP编程语言，提出了「人工智能」这个术语，坚信机器可以通过符号推理来实现智能。在课堂上，他总是迫不及待地想让学生亲自动手尝试。
bio.en: Invented the LISP programming language in 1958 and coined the term 「artificial intelligence」. A firm believer that machines can achieve intelligence through symbolic reasoning. In the classroom, he's always eager to get students experimenting hands-on.
